brief: The canvas presents a geometrically abstracted self-portrait rendered in three-point perspective, built from numerous interlocking, faceted planes. These planes are not solid but appear highly refractive and dynamic. The surface colors are saturated and subtly shifting, causing the edges to appear crisp and dramatic. The reflectivity of the planes changes constantly, catching and scattering the ambient light as if viewed from every possible angle, giving the geometric structure a sense of deep, breathing volume.
